safety_notes.text: Never invent missing combinations from option Cartesian products; menu tuples must resolve to exactly one existing non-test sale product.
Edition18 finish dictionary does not cover every legacy color. Existing BL/BK/NB/RG etc require title/spec/source checks; do not delete them just because absent in this edition.
Base models use longest exact confirmed match; IBS7009 vs IBS70, IBS12A vs IBS12 vs IBS1, BOX015FL vs BOX015F vs BOX015L vs BOX015.
Digits1/2/3/4/5/7 are only approved for documented configurable families above. Height/size/length digits elsewhere remain model-specific.
HB-prefixed rough-ins, EXT trims and complete products are different sale contents. Maintain separate grouping or explicit safe content distinction.
Book used for structural product rules, not mass price overwrite. No price update is authorized by this analysis.
IBS12/IBS12A default M360 is already round ABS13cm; option1 M376 is round3jet13cm. Staaf/Rond is wrong as a generic handshower label for these families.

Price-table model labels can conflict with heading/drawing: p329 M198 table saysM106, p330 M199 table saysM106, p363 M360 table saysM350, p417 BAA22 table saysBAA20. Candidate index retains those tokens; do not blindly trust extracted table models.
Heated rail set codes have rail count, shape, length, switch type and included-but-separately-ordered rough-in distinctions. Treat as review batch, not naive color-only merge.

IBS20 p202 Dutch heading + HB007 indicate2stopkranen while English/French translations saydiverter. Keep IBS20 distinct from IBS20A; verify actual manufacturer data if exposing control-type to customers.
Existing historical groups such as IBSW70 may not appear literally in this edition. Absence is not a reason to remove an existing working menu.
